Headings/paragraphs expose textTarget for replace_text and text formatting; paragraph formatting uses headings.paragraphTarget or paragraphs text + targetOccurrence. inspectDocxContentControls.description: Inspect main-document content controls: tag, alias, kind, bounded current text, part/paragraph location, exact mutation target with occurrence, and unsupported reasons. Copy target and complete text to set_content_control_text. Default 20, maximum 100 records; strings capped at 2000 characters. Truncated values cannot be used for mutation. Does not change XML.

inspectDocxFields.description: Inspect Word fields including TOC, PAGE, NUMPAGES, DATE, and unknown instructions. Returns bounded instruction and cached text separately, representation, part/paragraph location, dirty/locked flags when present, common TOC heading levels, and structural diagnostics. Main document and header/footer parts. Default 20, maximum 100 records; text capped at 2000 characters. Dirty means refresh requested; absent flags do not prove results are current. Does not calculate or edit fields.

inspectDocxImages.description: Inspect embedded images in body, cells, and header/footer parts. Default 20, maximum 100. Includes source-validated retrieval handles, format, intrinsic/display dimensions, alt text, ownership, layout and refusal diagnostics. No binary data in JSON.

inspectDocxLayout.description: Inspect structural section geometry, explicit pagination controls, table/image dimensions, floating-image positions/wrap, fresh image handles, and width warnings. No automatic page positions. Default returns summaries; blockLimit (0–100) and blockOffset request details; sectionIndex selects a zero-based section.

inspectDocxNotes.description: Inspect ordinary footnotes and endnotes, fresh handles, note IDs, text, zero-based body paragraph and source reference indexes, reference counts, structural status, and imported numbering settings. Separators are excluded and protected. IDs differ from visible note numbers. Default 20, maximum 100 records per page; note text capped at 2000 characters. Read-only.

inspectDocxSections.description: Inspect ordered Word sections with fresh handles, page setup, numbering, and owned/inherited header/footer variants. Re-inspect after every section edit.

inspectDocxStyleSnapshot.description: Inspects the bounded DOCX formatting system away from Node's event loop.

inspectDocxTrackedChanges.description: Inspect existing Word tracked insertions/deletions: IDs, author/date, bounded text, source-order paragraph locations, totals of XML records/markers, original Word element names (revisionType), and unsupported move/property/range diagnostics. Main document including tables only. Default 20, maximum 100 per page; text/metadata capped at 2000 characters. Current document text includes insertions and excludes deletions. Does not edit or save a version.

readDocxEmbeddedImage.description: Backend-only read of original embedded PNG/JPEG bytes (20 MiB / 64 million pixels maximum). Never register as a model-callable tool. Returns structured diagnostics and no imageBytes on failure; does not change the DOCX.

handle.description: Fresh handle from inspectDocxImages. Body/layout picture handles are not accepted.
